Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring that child protective service workers be licensed as social workers and bonded.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to child protective services workers; and adding anew section to chapter 26.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any child protective services worker who is directly engaged in:(1) Investigation of reports of alleged child abuse or neglect; (2)assessment of risk of abuse or neglect to children; or (3) provision ofor referral to services, including law enforcement, to remedyconditions that endanger the health, safety, and welfare of children,must be licensed in good standing in a social work classification underchapter 18.225 RCW, and bonded.
